title: CodeAzy
shortDescription: AI-powered code review and automation platform for developers.
description: A comprehensive platform that leverages AI to automate code reviews, suggest improvements, and streamline development workflows.
problem: Manual code reviews are time-consuming and inconsistent across teams.
planning: Designed an AI-first approach with human oversight for critical decisions.
development: Built with FastAPI backend, React frontend, and OpenAI integration.
architecture: Microservices architecture with Docker containers and PostgreSQL database.
challenges: Balancing AI suggestions with human judgment
Maintaining low latency for real-time feedback
solutions: Used streaming responses for instant feedback

title: DevOps Dashboard
shortDescription: Real-time monitoring and deployment dashboard for server infrastructure.
description: A comprehensive dashboard for monitoring server health, managing deployments, and visualizing infrastructure metrics.
problem: Managing multiple servers without centralized monitoring was inefficient.
planning: Built a lightweight dashboard that aggregates metrics from multiple sources.
development: Developed with FastAPI for real-time WebSocket updates and Docker for deployment.
architecture: Event-driven architecture with Redis for caching and WebSocket for live updates.
challenges: Handling real-time data from multiple sources
Ensuring low resource usage on monitoring agent
solutions: Created lightweight Python agent for servers

title: API Gateway
shortDescription: Lightweight API gateway with rate limiting and authentication.
description: A fast, configurable API gateway built with FastAPI for managing multiple backend services.
problem: Need for a centralized entry point for multiple microservices.
planning: Designed a lightweight gateway with essential features.
development: Built with FastAPI for high performance and Redis for rate limiting.
architecture: Proxy architecture with middleware chain for auth, rate limiting, and logging.
challenges: Maintaining low latency under high load
solutions: Used Redis for fast rate limit checks

title: Portfolio Website
shortDescription: Modern developer portfolio built with Next.js and Three.js.
description: This very portfolio website, showcasing modern web development with animations and 3D elements.
problem: Need a professional online presence to showcase projects and skills.
planning: Designed a premium, interactive portfolio with smooth animations.
development: Built with Next.js for performance and Three.js for 3D elements.
architecture: Static generation with client-side interactivity for animations.
